expectation.text: A third-party bar widget that reports its full width through implicitWidth should get a Powerbar slot wide enough to show its whole readout.

payload.observed: On Powerbar 0.9.6 a new third-party bar widget built as one qs.Ui WidgetButton (its own label hidden, a Row of Text readings inside, fixedWidth set from the Row) showed only about its first 160 logical px: 'CPU 7% 69°C RAM 8.4/' of a readout roughly 330 px long. It stayed clipped after the readings settled and after a shell restart. Powerbar sizes each slot from the painted width it measures, and CellModel.js caps 'free text' at MAX_INK = 160 px unless the slot has two or more click targets (Bar.qml passes the cap flag as !root.vertical && compoundTargets.length < 2). The stock omarchy.bar was not tested.
payload.title: Powerbar clips a wide one-button text bar widget at 160 px
